# Exercise list

<!-- Generated by `make index` (python3 -m pn.index) from pn/catalog.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Every Petri net exercise from the IMS study material, grouped by category: basic models first, then single mechanisms as in the short exam questions, then marking at time t, then full word problems as at the midterm. Within a category, newer tasks come first. *Původ* says where the task comes from; the note's last section has the details.

Each note shows only the task when opened. Try the exercise first, then open the hidden sections one at a time: the hint, the net, the common mistakes, the SIMLIB model, the sources. Every note also exists as a PDF next to it.

Status: `drafted` = built and passing `make check`, the interpretation not yet confirmed (section *Interpretace*); `reviewed` = the interpretation is confirmed (section *Nápověda*); `todo` = not built yet.
